en.headline: Observatory forecasts cooler midweek as northeast monsoon arrives
en.dek: A fresh northeast monsoon is expected to reach the south China coast on Tuesday, bringing rain and lower temperatures through midweek.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a fresh to strong easterly airstream would affect the coast of Guangdong on Monday, bringing cloudy weather with one or two rain patches.
The northeast monsoon is forecast to arrive on Tuesday morning. Weather will become cool with rain more frequent at first, and temperatures are expected to fall to between 18 and 23 degrees.

Wednesday is expected to remain cool, especially in the morning and at night, with a temperature range of 16 to 20 degrees and cloudy conditions with occasional rain. Conditions are forecast to improve from Thursday with bright periods and rising temperatures toward the weekend.
The Observatory advised the public to prepare for the cooler midweek period and to check updated forecasts as the monsoon arrives.

zh.headline: 天文台料周二東北季候風抵港 本周中期轉涼有雨
zh.dek: 一股清勁東北季候風預料周二抵達華南沿岸，本周中期氣溫下降及有幾陣雨，其後天氣逐漸好轉。
body: 香港天文台表示，受一股清勁至強風程度的偏東氣流影響，周一華南沿岸大致多雲，有一兩陣雨。
東北季候風預料周二早上抵達華南沿岸，天氣轉涼，初時雨勢較頻密，氣溫介乎18至23度。
周三仍然清涼，早上及晚間尤其明顯，氣溫介乎16至20度，多雲有一兩陣雨。周四起天氣逐漸改善，下午有陽光時間，氣溫回升，周末大致天晴。
天文台提醒市民留意本周中期轉涼的天氣，並留意最新預報。
